The Department of Business Administration at East West University (EWU) offers undergraduate and graduate programs. The undergraduate program is a Bachelor of Business Administration (BBA), which requires a minimum of 123 credits. Graduate programs include a Master of Business Administration (MBA) and an Executive MBA (EMBA).

The BBA curriculum is designed to equip students with contemporary business knowledge and skills, covering areas such as Accounting, Marketing, Finance, Management, International Business, Human Resource Management, and Management Information Systems. The program emphasizes practical insights into business creation, innovation, and management.

The department aims to create an enabling environment for students to become successful business leaders, aligning with its vision of "Business Knowledge Leadership for Social Transformation." If you have more specific questions about the programs or faculty, feel free to ask!
